question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**from**" is used to indicate the source or origin of something.
 
• In the context of the passage, **"applications of Mechanical Engineering are omnipresent and inseparable from society"** means that Mechanical Engineering applications are an integral part of society.
 
• The other options: "**off**," "**by**," and "**of**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Applications of Mechanical Engineering are omnipresent and inseparable from__ society.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Off (दूर)**: used to indicate separation or disconnection.
 
• **By (द्वारा)**: used to indicate the agent performing an action.
 
• **Of (का/की/के)**: used to indicate belonging or relationship.
